essence: The ritual diagram begins with a lotus on birch bark bearing dhruva in its pericarp.
The syllables śrīṃ, hrīṃ, and klīṃ should be inscribed in the filaments in the eight directions.
These named elements form a single mantra kūṭa.
Elements are to be placed in pairs in the filaments of the outer sixteen-petaled lotus.
A specific ordered mantra sequence is to be inscribed at this stage.
